changelog:
Initial release of the afrexai-board-meeting skill.

- Instantly generates comprehensive board meeting packages, including agenda, financial dashboards, KPI deep dives, risk registers, and action trackers.
- Clear instructions for preparing meeting materials tailored to company performance and needs.
- Provides structured templates for executive summaries, detailed financials, strategic updates, and board decisions.
- Includes pre- and post-meeting checklists, plus practical tips for effective board communications.
- Offers links to industry-specific context packs and automation tools.
